rationale: Despite a strong bearish catalyst from an earnings miss and heavy relative volume (8.24x), the stock is already heavily extended down nearly 19% from the prior close and is consolidating on low 1-minute volume right at session lows ($13.08-$13.13) heading into the midday lull. Shorting at the bottom of the range offers poor reward-to-risk against a midday bounce toward the 5-minute 9-EMA ($13.20) or VWAP ($13.53), while going long lacks any higher-low structure or buying volume to fight the dominant downtrend.
